property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, transfer always returns true and does not revert; for an empty _tos it must revert.
If _tos.length > 0 then transfer returns (i.e., does not revert); it may revert only when _tos.length == 0.
When _tos has length 1, transfer either returns true (no revert) or reverts, but if it returns it must return true (i.e., a non-reverting call yields true).
If transfer is called with a non-empty _tos array, the call does not revert and returns true (i.e., non-reverting implies true) — tested for exactly one recipient to simplify reasoning.
For any non-empty _tos array of length 1, a non-reverting call to transfer returns true.
